item.text: I’ll trace how the board loads its issues and align its filtering with the rest of the product.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "rg -n -i 'board' src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts src/server/services/issue-service.ts 'src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/projects/[projectSlug]' src/components/domain/issue; cat src/lib/soft-delete.ts; sed -n '1,160p' src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts; sed -n '230,310p' src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts"
